_description: Example 4 — single reach, 3 profiles, FWOP (current authorized schedule) vs FWP (proposed, more proactive nourishment). Schema-v2 authoring: a global `nourishment` plan table keyed by plan id, referenced per reach by key; `storm`/`erosion`/`slc` are hoisted to the global level (shared across plans, layered global->reach->alt). The restore geometry is parametric (synthesized per profile from its as-built fit; omit `template_geometry` to restore to as-built), so the two plans share the restore target, production rate, and costs and differ only in the volume trigger. 8 storms at 90-day spacing leaves room for annual nourishment windows.

Reach1._note: reach1_p0=LOW_UPLAND(BE≈2.44m), p1=LOW_BERM(BE≈1.83m), p2=HIGH_UPLAND(BE≈2.44m). berm_elevation is reach-wide; p1 berm detection is approximate.
